name: app-builder
description: Takes a non-technical person from an idea to a ready-to-build project: asks plain-English questions, installs the MERN template, writes their answers into the six spec sheets, starts a local MongoDB and Postgres that need no installing, and offers to build v1. Ships two more skills: code-report for a readable record of every change, and app-docs for a Stripe-style reference site for the finished app.
